name: inspect_memory_space
description: Return current usage and shared capacity across memory rooms.

name: browse_memory
description: Browse persistent memory shared across sessions. Inspect metadata without reading content, or list a room's immediate entries. Results are sorted by address; other sessions can change entries between pages.

address.description: Literal path relative to the shared entrance, '.'. Omit to browse the entrance; use find_memory for name patterns.

entry_only.description: Return only the addressed entry or room's metadata; defaults to false.

recursive_size.description: Measure the combined size of memories in each returned room and its descendants. Defaults to false, leaving room size_bytes null.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset from the previous reply; null means no more results.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page, default 100. The encoded reply limit can shorten a page.

name: find_memory
description: Locate entries and rooms by name within a room and its descendants. Results are sorted by address; other sessions can change matches between pages.

query.description: Name or name pattern to find. Literal matching finds part of a name.

room.description: Room address relative to the shared entrance. Omit to search from the entrance, '.'.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset from the previous reply; null means no more results.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page, default 100. The encoded reply limit can shorten a page.

name: recall_memory
description: Locate text by matching lines within a room and its descendants. Results are sorted by address and line; other sessions can change matches between pages. Each line has a bounded text preview and text_truncated; use read_memory for complete content.

clue.description: The text or pattern to find in memory entries.

room.description: Room address relative to the shared entrance. Omit to search from the entrance, '.'.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset from the previous reply; null means no more results.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page, default 100. The encoded reply limit can shorten a page.

name: read_memory
description: Read an entry's content as text pages or a complete supported image. Replies retain source byte_length and an unavailable diagnostic when content cannot be supplied.

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

interpretation.description: Present the entry's complete nonempty text as an image URL. Omit for automatic byte detection.

offset.description: Byte offset at a UTF-8 character boundary, default 0. Continue with a non-null next_offset; null means the end. Images and image_url interpretation require offset 0.

max_bytes.description: Maximum text bytes per page, default 8192. UTF-8 boundaries and the encoded reply limit can shorten a page. Complete images and image_url interpretation use their own limits.

name: remember
description: Store text or copy a host file into an entry, with a limit of 32 MiB for both transferred content and the updated entry. Failed preparation preserves the previous entry.

address.description: The location for the memory entry, relative to the shared entrance.

path.description: Regular source file on Ivenna's host, absolute or relative to its startup directory.

content.description: Source of the content to store.

mode.description: create (default) requires a new entry; append adds bytes without a separator and creates a missing entry. Both require existing parent rooms. replace overwrites or creates the entry, creating missing parent rooms. Replacing or appending changes only the addressed hard-linked name.

name: revise_memory
description: Revise UTF-8 text, with a 32 MiB limit for both the existing and revised entry. Replace one unique match by default: no match reports no_match, and multiple matches return ambiguous_match without writing. Replies report revision and matches.

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

new_text.description: The replacement text. Regex mode expands captures such as ${1} and ${name}; literal mode keeps this text as supplied.

replace_all.description: Replace every non-overlapping match instead of one unique match. Defaults to false.

name: create_memory_room
description: Create a memory room and any missing parent rooms. An existing room is reused.

address.description: The new room location, relative to the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Move or rename a memory entry or a room and its contents. An occupied target is reported as an error.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

destination.description: The new location, or an existing room to move into. Both are relative to the shared entrance.

name: forget_memory
description: Remove a memory entry or an empty room.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

recursive.description: Remove all entries and child rooms at this location. Omit to remove only an entry or an empty room.
